clusters.name: After grandfather's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Your mother's anxiety rose as she lay awake over money around March 1988, and by May 1988 she had stopped talking with your father about it. Your grandfather died in July 1989. Around the same time, your brother's grades fell. By March 1990 your mother was calmer once back at work. These shifts cluster around your grandfather's death and what was happening in your parents' marriage at the time.

clusters.name: After your mother's cancer diagnosis, 1994–1996
clusters.reason: You left home for college in September 1993. Within months, in March 1994, migraines kept you in bed. You then called your brother most nights, but by June 1995, after your mother was told she had breast cancer in February 1995, you stopped returning his calls. By February 1996 you had stopped calling home. Your symptoms rose, your functioning fell, and your relationships shifted as your mother faced a serious diagnosis.
